name: textgen (text-generation-webui)
what: oobabooga's text-generation-webui, renamed textgen in 2026: a Gradio web UI and desktop app with several loaders (llama.cpp, ExLlamaV3, Transformers) and an OpenAI-compatible API on a port of its own, with internal routes that load, unload and list models. Portable builds per platform and backend; a model folder it loads from by name.

version.note: no version string in the program; the portable build's folder name carries the release (4.9). The update check compares releases.

detect.note: the API must be on (--api, in CMD_FLAGS.txt or the start script); the web UI's own port (7860) is not the API. One server is one unit; model_id is a name from /v1/internal/model/list.

auth.note: only when --admin-key (or --api-key) is set; the admin key opens the load and unload routes

endpoints.info: GET /v1/internal/model/info (model_name is "None" when nothing is loaded)

can: start a unit from its start script
load a model by name and unload it through the internal API
cannot: see busy: the API has no idle flag; an unload during a generation is the program's own affair
choose the loader or its arguments from here: they are the model's saved settings, or the `args` the owner adds to the unit's table
drive.note: Table from the source (modules/api/script.py, 2026-11-07). The repository was quiet from August to November 2026. Not yet driven from any machine.

never: --listen or --public-api without --api-key: the API has no login otherwise

update.note: A one-click install updates with its update wizard; a portable build is replaced by unpacking the new zip (about 900 MB with CUDA) beside the old one and moving user_data across.

windows: Portable: download textgen-portable-<ver>-windows-cuda<ver>.zip from the releases page, unpack, run start_windows.bat
Full: git clone https://github.com/oobabooga/textgen, run start_windows.bat (installs Miniconda and the loaders)

good: one place for GGUF, EXL3 and Transformers models with a UI, characters and extensions
a loader per model, chosen in the UI and remembered
not: speed: each loader is the upstream engine with Gradio in front
a server that is only a server: llama.cpp or TabbyAPI are lighter
